Pain reliever
Nighttime sleep-aid

list.item: more than 3 doses (30 mL each) in 24 hours, which is the maximum daily amount for this product
3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product

text.paragraph: Allergy alert:Acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions. Symptoms may include:
If a skin reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away.
Sore throat warning:If sore throat is severe, persists for more than 2 days, is accompanied or followed by fever, headache, rash, nausea, or vomiting, consult a doctor promptly.

list.item: with any other drug containing acetaminophen (prescription or nonprescription). If you are not sure whether a drug contains acetaminophen, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
for children under 12 years of age
with any other product containing diphenhydramine, even one used on skin

paragraph.content: Ask a doctor before use if you have

list.item: a breathing problem such as emphysema or chronic bronchitis
difficulty in urination due to enlargement of the prostate gland

paragraph.content: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are

list.item: taking the blood thinning drug warfarin

paragraph.content: Stop use and ask a doctor if

list.item: pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days
fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days
sleeplessness persists continuously for more than 2 weeks.

text.paragraph: Insomnia may be a symptom of serious underlying medical illness.
